title: Terms of Service — Kiron
description: Kiron terms of service — the rules and conditions for using the Kiron AI workout tracker app.
body:

2. Description of Service

Kiron is a fitness tracking application that allows users to import, manage, and log workout programs. The App is available on iOS and Android platforms.

3. Subscriptions

Kiron is offered on a subscription basis. Subscriptions are available on a weekly or annual basis. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID or Google Play account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

You may manage and cancel your subscription through your device's account settings. No refunds are provided for unused portions of a subscription period.

4. Free Trial

We may offer a free trial period for new subscribers. If you do not cancel before the trial ends, you will be automatically charged for the subscription. Only one free trial is permitted per user.

5. User Accounts

You must create an account to use Kiron. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

6. User Data

You retain ownership of the workout data you enter into the App. By using the App, you grant us a limited license to store and process your data solely to provide the service. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

7. Prohibited Use

We do not warrant that the App will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free, that any workout programs, recommendations, or content will be accurate or appropriate for you, or that any particular results will be achieved. Your use of the App is at your own risk.

13. Changes to Terms
